name: IG3000 Display Multichannel Controller
shortDescription: Bring compatible digital and analog water sensors together in a multichannel controller with a clear display and menu navigation. Configurable outputs, relays and communication options support process integration, while an output-hold function assists with sensor maintenance.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Strong compatibility, able to connect digital and analog sensors from Igno company
◆90 * 70 large screen LED display, user-friendly interface
◆Large size UV resistant and anti-corrosion PS shell, suitable for various harsh working conditions.
◆4-20mA output with control function, capable of PID control of external devices
◆ Optional multiple relays, Modbus RTU, DeviceNet, Modbus RS232, CANopen, EthermetIP, Modbus TCP, TCP/IP communication, etc., can meet various on-site requirements
◆ Multi channel controller, capable of connecting one or more sensors
◆ Output hold function, convenient for sensor maintenance
◆IP66 protection level, CE certification.

Technical parameters:

Display: High resolution full-color large screen LED display screen
Operation mode: Key menu navigation
Operation interface: Chinese/English
Number of channels: 1-8
Supporting parameters: PH、ORP、 Turbidity, residual chlorine, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, blue-green algae, chlorophyll, chromaticity, transparency UVCOD、 Ammonia nitrogen, sludge concentration, suspended solids, nitrate nitrogen, etc
Units: pH, mV, mg/L, us/cm, cm, ppb, ppm, ℃,% NTU and others
Support temperature sensors: PT100、PT1000、NTC10/30K
Internal power supply: 5V/12V/24V
Relay: 1-4 channels 220VAC 3A, programmable
Analog output: optional 2-8 4-20mA outputs
Digital Communication: ModbusRS485、DeviceNet、ModbusRS232、CANopen、EthermetIP、ModbusTCP,TCP/IP，Profibus
Output hold function: Yes
Size: 200mm * 200mm * 70mm
Installation method: Wall mounted
Shell material: Poly+PS
Work environment:- 10~50℃
Protection level: Compliant with IP66 NEMA 4X
Electrical interface: M16*1.5
Power supply: 100~240VAC, 50/60Hz
Certification: EMC: CE certification, electromagnetic and radiation emissions comply with EN 50081-2, anti-interference complies with EN 61000-6-2
